description.default: A draggable, interactive desktop pet that reacts to AI run status. Supports two sprite forms (Deepy the whale and the whale girl). Long press for the menu; size and display timing are configurable.
description.zh-CN: 可拖拽、可点击互动的桌面宠物：跟随 AI 运行状态变化，支持 Deepy 鲸与鲸娘两种形态动画，长按打开菜单，可在配置页调整大小与显示时机。
